integrity: Proof relies on explicit carry-free presentation, reduced path acyclicity by digraph homotopies, and an integral free deck-group resolution. Executable checks are finite corroboration, not proof of the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: This is a conditional-parameter family, requiring q>=3 and n>2 max S, and only concerns GLMY integral path homology. The abstract Cayley 2-cover mechanism is prior work; a previously published arbitrary-downset contraction would diminish originality. Neither directed homotopy type nor unstable moduli are classified.
title: Integral path homology of carry-free face-step circulants
